1.pT: Sô, ano toki wa mô, suicchi ga haittetan ja nai kanâ

2.pT: Zutto mae kara shikumareteta, sonna deaitte, shinziru?

3.pT: Te to te, Kata to kata, Senaka to senaka, sorekara. Fuku no ue kara datte iinda

4.pT: Sôzô o koete wakari aeterutte, kanjiru toki ga aru. Gyaku no toki mo ôi kedone

5.pT: Jama o suru no ga chikashii ningen dake o wa kagiranai. Shiranai hito hodo, te kibishii

6.pT: Nayami o wasureru ii hôhô. Tanin no toraburu ni kubi o tsukkon de miruttenowa, dô?

7.pT: Imêji owa don don kôchiku shinakya. Tada de sae, hashi kara kuzureteku mono nandakara

8.pT: Jikan ga naitoki hido, ôku no koto ga dekiru. Yatteshimau. Mochiron, koi datte

9.pT: Omoide ni ki no kiita shinario wa iranai. Kuchi kara deta shunkan, dôse minna tawagoto

10.pT: Hitori zumô ga murashii no wa, hitori dakaratte dake ja nai. Kankyaku no me ga, itainda.

11.pT: Mune ni tsukaete iru koto o, toki wa kaiketsu shite kurenai. Bôkyaku no raberu o harudake de.

12.pT: Shibaru koto. Azamuku koto. Ubau koto. Ataeru koto. Doreyori tsurai no ga, matsu koto.

13.pT: Utsuwa ga katamute iru no ni, kizukanakatta? Mô mizu wa itteki mo nokotte nakatta karane

1.pT: Chûningu ga atta tameshi ga nai. Motto Ryôkô na basho ga aru to omotteshimau

2.pT: Mitsukaranaimono ga, mawari o kowasu. Soko ni nai kara, te no uchiyou ga nai

3.pT: Chiisaikoro o omotte, hazukashisa ni mimorae suru koto ga aru. Sore ni kurabereba

4.pT: Baretehoshii uso ga aru. Shinjite hoshikunai hontou ga aru. Hitotsuzutsu, aru

5.pT: Mushi ga yosugirunjanai? Kara ni tojikomotteru kuse ni, heisho kyoufushou nante

6.pT: Akirukara tsugi ni susumeru to iu. Daitai wa, susumumae ni mou akiterumitai dakedo

7.pT: Ren'ai wa rikutsu janai. Sou katariau koibitotachi wa, shijin, hyouronka, tetsugakusha

8.pT: Wakaremichi made modoritai to omou. Migi ni sureba yokattatte. Koukai dake no sonna michisuji

13.pT: We were sitting together all night long, not even being able to move a single inch
